verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own accounting integration: "One-click sync with NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero", with transactions exporting reference IDs and timestamps. That replaces some manual entry, but nothing shows the sync is real-time or bidirectional, and the claim sits on the Instant Pay marketing page. Webhooks and APIs are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: evidence of real-time sync, evidence of bidirectional data flow (e.g., GL/chart-of-accounts mapping pulled from the ERP), automated journal-entry creation details, coverage across cards/expenses beyond Instant Pay, in-depth integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
